a.description: array_like Coefficient tensor, of shape ``b.shape + Q``. `Q`, a tuple, equals the shape of that sub-tensor of `a` consisting of the appropriate number of its rightmost indices, and must be such that ``prod(Q) == prod(b.shape)`` (in which sense `a` is said to be 'square').
constraints: shape: b.shape + Q, where prod(Q) == prod(b.shape)
a must be 'square' for successful inversion

b.description: array_like Right-hand tensor, which can be of any shape.

axes.description: tuple of ints, optional Axes in `a` to reorder to the right, before inversion. If None (default), no reordering is done.
